prepare:
Sub Prepare()
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Do While Worksheets.Count > 1
Worksheets(Worksheets.Count).Delete
Loop
Worksheets(1).Name = "Left"
Worksheets.Add(After:=Worksheets(1)).Name = "Right"
Worksheets.Add(After:=Worksheets(2)).Name = "Blank"
End Sub
helpers:
Public Log As String
Public LC As Long, RC As Long
Function Tick(value As Double, label As String, Optional makeVolatile As Boolean = False) As Double
Application.Volatile makeVolatile
If label = "L" Then
LC = LC + 1
Else
RC = RC + 1
End If
Tick = value * 10
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Snapshot = CStr(Worksheets("Left").Range("A1").Value2) & ":" & CStr(Worksheets("Left").Range("B1").Value2) & ":" & CStr(Worksheets("Right").Range("B1").Value2) & ":" & LC & ":" & RC
End Function
book_handler:
Private Sub Workbook_SheetCalculate(ByVal Sh As Object)
Log = Log & "book:" & Sh.Name & ";"
End Sub
sheet_handler:
Private Sub Worksheet_Calculate()
Log = Log & "sheet:" & Me.Name & ";"
End Sub
